title: SentinelMesh EnergySample (NRG line)
description: One power reading from the INA219 monitor board, sent as `NRG <json>`. Continuous telemetry, deliberately NOT an Event. The console validates each sample before storing it; GET /energy serves them to the frontend.

ts.description: epoch ms, or device millis() -- the bridge replaces values below 1e12 with arrival time. Optional: the console stamps arrival time if absent.

amps.description: signed: INA219 reports negative current if the shunt is wired backwards, which should be visible, not clipped

battery_pct.description: derived from volts by the monitor; optional because the INA219 does not measure it directly

node.description: the node being measured; defaults to field-1

source.description: `sim` marks console-side simulated samples (tools/mock_rig.py) so the UI can say SIMULATED and nobody quotes those numbers. Hardware omits it.
